title: Where does the quantum advantage go? Reproduction package
description: Code and result files for the article Where does the quantum advantage go? An audit of evolutionary algorithms executed on quantum circuits (manuscript in preparation for Quantum Machine Intelligence). Includes an exact sparse simulator over Z[ζ16], the exact certificates for the reduced quantum genetic algorithm and the structural verifier for product-state circuits.
